acceptance_criteria: cargo test --workspace passes; check_no_crlf is pub(crate) accessible from mdn.rs
description:
The private fn check_no_crlf in crate-jmap-mail-server/src/submission.rs line 653 is needed by the MDN/send handler (mdn.rs) to validate that string fields used as RFC 5322 header values contain no embedded CRLF.

What: visibility change from fn to pub(crate) fn.

Algorithm:
1. Open crate-jmap-mail-server/src/submission.rs.
2. Change 'fn check_no_crlf(email: &str) -> bool' to 'pub(crate) fn check_no_crlf(s: &str) -> bool'.
   (Rename parameter from 'email' to 's' since it is used for any string, not only email addresses.)
3. Run cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings.
4. Run cargo test --workspace.

Defensive rules:
- Touch only the visibility and parameter name; do not change the function body.
- Confirm the existing callers in submission.rs still compile after the rename.
title: mdn: promote check_no_crlf to pub(crate) in submission.rs
